# compliance

Compliance audits and policies.

- Toolset name: `compliance`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 13 (4 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_create_audit`

**Create audit** · mutating

Create a compliance audit binding a target, a policy (as `scan_config_id`) and a scanner. Returns the new audit's UUID.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent_group_id` | string | no | UUID of the agent group (agentGroup tasks) |
| `alert_ids` | array<string> | no | Optional alert UUIDs to attach |
| `alterable` | boolean | no | Whether the task stays modifiable after the first run |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `name` | string | yes | Task name |
| `observers` | array<string> | no | Login names of users allowed to observe the task |
| `oci_image_target_id` | string | no | UUID of the OCI image target (ociImage tasks) |
| `preferences` | object<string, string> | no | Key-value scan preferences, e.g. {"max_checks": "4"} |
| `scan_config_id` | string | no | UUID of the scan config (required for classic tasks, rejected for other variants) |
| `scanner_id` | string | no | UUID of the scanner (required for every non-import task) |
| `schedule_id` | string | no | Optional schedule UUID |
| `schedule_periods` | integer | no | Number of schedule periods to run (0 = unlimited) |
| `target_id` | string | no | UUID of the scan target (classic tasks) |
| `type` | string | no | Task variant: "classic" (default; host target + scan config), "agentGroup", "ociImage", "webApplication" or "import" (a container task for openvas_import_report that accepts only name/comment). Non-classic variants are inferred from their selector when omitted. |
| `web_application_target_id` | string | no | UUID of the web application target (webApplication tasks) |

### `openvas_create_policy`

**Create policy** · mutating

Create a compliance policy as a copy of an existing one. Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base_policy_id` | string | yes | UUID of the active policy to copy from (see openvas_list_policies) |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `name` | string | yes | Policy name |

**Delete audit** · destructive

Delete a compliance audit.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_delete_policy`

**Delete policy** · destructive

Delete a compliance policy. Fails with 409 if an audit still uses it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_list_audits`

**List audits** · read-only

List compliance audits with status and progress.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_list_policies`

**List policies** · read-only

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |

| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |
